outputs.notes: Repository (features/learning-time/server/repository.ts) exports: getSessionRow(id, householdId), getActiveSessionRow(householdId, learnerId) [non-finalized session, at most one per learner], createSessionRow(householdId, CreateSessionRowInput) [status='draft'; throws Error('Learner already has an active learning time session') if an active session already exists], updateSessionRow(id, householdId, SessionRowPatch), listFinalizedSessionRows(householdId, SessionListFilters{learnerId?,from?,to?}) [status='finalized', from/to filter on endedAt]. Also exports type LearningTimeSessionRow = typeof learningTimeSessions.$inferSelect. Service (features/learning-time/server/service.ts) exports: createSession(householdId, CreateSessionInput), getActiveSession(householdId, learnerId), listSessions(householdId, SessionListFilters), transitionSession(id, householdId, SessionTransitionInput{action:'start'|'pause'|'resume'|'end'|'finalize', outcome?, notes?}) — all return the domain LearningTimeSession (features/learning-time/types.ts), which mirrors the DB row but with ISO date strings plus a server-computed `elapsedSeconds: number`. Error classes: SessionNotFoundError, InvalidTransitionError (both exported from service.ts). Transition rules: start requires status='draft'; pause/resume require status='running'/'paused' respectively AND timeChannelType !== 'scheduled'; end allowed from 'running' or 'paused', sets endedAt=now and computes endedBy ('time' if a timer's elapsed >= targetMinutes*60 or a scheduled session's scheduledEnd has passed, else 'manual'); finalize requires status='ended', sets outcome/notes and status='finalized'. KNOWN SIMPLIFICATION (documented for Phase 2+): elapsedSeconds is wall-clock from startedAt to (endedAt ?? pausedAt-if-paused ?? now) — a single pause/resume cycle is supported but resuming does not subtract paused duration from elapsedSeconds (no accumulator column in schema).

phases.title: Phase 1 — learning-time API routes + router wiring

outputs.notes: features/learning-time/api/routes/learning-time.ts exports POST (create, body: {learnerId, timeChannelType, subjectId?, lessonTaskId?, targetMinutes?, scheduledStart?, scheduledEnd?} -> 201 {status,data:LearningTimeSession,message,timestamp}; 400 if learnerId/timeChannelType missing or invalid, or if service/repo rejects due to an existing active session for the learner), GET (list, query ?learnerId=&from=&to= -> 200 {data: LearningTimeSession[]} of finalized sessions), GET_ACTIVE (query ?learnerId= required, 400 if missing -> 200 {data: LearningTimeSession | null}), PATCH (body: {action: 'start'|'pause'|'resume'|'end'|'finalize', outcome?, notes?} -> 200 {data: LearningTimeSession}; 400 for invalid/unknown action or InvalidTransitionError, 404 via SessionNotFoundError if the session id doesn't exist for the household). All routes call features/learning-time/server/service.ts (createSession/getActiveSession/listSessions/transitionSession) — never the repository directly. POST uses guardOwnership + assertSessionOwnership('learner', learnerId); GET/GET_ACTIVE/PATCH rely on householdId scoping in the service/repository (no extra ownership check, matching attendance/quran precedent). Router: features/learning-time/api/router.ts handleLearningTimeRoute — POST/GET '/sessions', GET '/sessions/active', PATCH '/sessions/:id' (slug[1] as id). Wired into app/api/[...slug]/route.ts via `if (slug[0] === 'learning-time')`. Front client features/learning-time/front/services/api.ts exports learningTimeApi.{createSession(input: CreateSessionInput), transition(id, input: SessionTransitionInput), getActive(learnerId): Promise<ApiResponse<LearningTimeSession|null>>, list(filters: SessionListFilters)} — all response shapes are LearningTimeSession (features/learning-time/types.ts) exactly as returned by the service layer (includes server-computed elapsedSeconds; getActive's data is null when no active session exists). Phase 4 (NowCard) should consume learningTimeApi directly with these exact shapes.

Route: /learning-time (app/(shell)/learning-time/page.tsx, thin wrapper rendering LearningTimePage). LearningTimePage.tsx: learner selector (data-testid=learner-select) defaults to the first active learner and follows ?childId=, mirroring AttendancePage; empty state data-testid=learning-time-empty ('No active children. Add one to get started.') when no active learners. Renders <NowCard learnerId={selectedChildId}/>. NowCard.tsx data-testids per state: now-card (outer wrapper), now-card-loading, now-card-idle, now-card-config, now-card-running, now-card-paused, now-card-ended, now-card-finalized. Action buttons: start-session-button (idle->config), start-button + cancel-config-button (config), pause-button/resume-button + finish-button (running/paused), save-outcome-button (ended), start-another-button (finalized). Config form fields: lesson-select ('adhoc' or today's next lessonTask id), subject-select (ad-hoc only), channel-stopwatch/channel-timer/channel-scheduled radios, target-minutes-input (timer), scheduled-start-input/scheduled-end-input (scheduled, type=time combined with today's date into ISO before createSession). 'Active session' detection on mount: NowCard calls learningTimeApi.getActive(learnerId) in a useEffect; while pending shows now-card-loading; result session.status drives the rendered state directly (draft->config, running/paused->elapsed view, ended->outcome form, null->idle). Elapsed time display (data-testid=elapsed-time, aria-live='polite') = session.elapsedSeconds (server value at fetch/transition time) + seconds-since-fetch while status==='running', via a 1s setInterval — never reset to zero on refresh. Draft/config 'Start' button: if session.status==='draft' (recovered from getActive) calls transition(id,{action:'start'}) directly; otherwise calls createSession(input) then transition(newId,{action:'start'}) — single click covers create+start since the API has no update-draft endpoint. 'Next' preview sourced from plannerApi.getLessons(undefined,[learnerId]) filtered to status='not_started' && dueDate===today. Phase 5 (dashboard entry) should use learningTimeApi.getActive(learnerId) the same way to build the 'Resume session' variant.
